import json

fpath = "/home/ubuntu/.claude-account-2/projects/-home-ubuntu--agent-ml-research-idea-gen-0509-12-projects-simgate-modular-routing/4bac371d-3a98-4ea3-bb9a-48482efb4493/tool-results/mcp-agent-ml-research-read_registry-1779531846841.txt"

with open(fpath, 'r') as f:
    raw = f.read()

outer = json.loads(raw)
inner_str = outer.get("result", outer)
if isinstance(inner_str, str):
    inner = json.loads(inner_str)
else:
    inner = inner_str

data = inner
if "data" in data:
    data = data["data"]
experiments = data.get("experiments", {})

target_ids = [
    "plan-012-full",
    "plan-003-baseline-245eps",
    "plan-004-ablation-b",
    "plan-011-rule-based",
    "math-extension-n800",
    "backbone-scaling-70b",
    "reflexion-dose-response-n345",
    "retry-dose-response",
    "daf-sensitivity-extended",
    "llama-cross-model-full",
    "gemma-scienceworld-v5",
    "alfworld-cross-env-full",
    "alfworld-llama-cross-model",
    "alfworld-llama-v3",
]

for eid in target_ids:
    print("=" * 80)
    if eid in experiments:
        exp = experiments[eid]
        print(f"exp_id: {eid}")
        print(f"status: {exp.get('status', 'N/A')}")
        
        metrics = exp.get('metrics', {})
        print(f"metrics:")
        if metrics:
            print(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        else:
            print("  (no metrics)")
        
        conclusion = exp.get('conclusion', None)
        print(f"conclusion: {conclusion if conclusion else '(not present)'}")
    else:
        # Try fuzzy match
        candidates = [k for k in experiments if eid.split('-')[0] in k and any(p in k for p in eid.split('-')[1:])]
        print(f"exp_id: {eid} -- NOT FOUND")
        if candidates:
            print(f"  Possible matches: {candidates}")
    print()

PYEOF
